short_summary: A Convertible Note Purchase Agreement for HealthRate, Inc. authorizing the issuance of up to $1,000,000 of convertible promissory notes to investors, with proceeds to be used for general corporate purposes.
long_summary: HealthRate, Inc., a Nevada corporation, entered into a Convertible Note Purchase Agreement dated August 30, 2024. The agreement allows the company to issue convertible promissory notes with a maximum aggregate principal amount of $1,000,000. The notes are to be sold to investors listed in Schedule I, with the funding directed toward general corporate purposes. The document outlines the company’s incorporation status, capital structure (17.5 million authorized shares, 10.5875 million issued, 6.9125 million reserved for an equity incentive plan), and includes signatures from CEO Tim Michaels and Investor Chairman James A. Bowen. The agreement is governed by Delaware law and includes standard provisions for closing, amendments, and notice.
